title: Vista: Recipes
description: This mod adds crafting recipes for all cassettes in the "Vista" mod and "Vista - All The Cassettes!".
body:
## This mod adds crafting recipes for all cassettes in the "Vista" mod and "Vista - All The Cassettes!".

This simple but very useful addition adds the ability to craft every cassette from the original **Vista** mod and **Vista - All The Cassettes**. No more relying on luck when looting chests, trading with villagers, or mob drops — now you can create your favorite cassettes yourself!

**What the mod adds:**

*   A new base item — **Cassette Base**, which is used as the main ingredient for all recipes.
*   Individual balanced recipes for each cassette, including `axolotl`, `block_wave`, `frogs`, `maze3d`, `space_sniffer`, and many more.
*   All recipes are fully integrated into the recipe book and follow the vanilla crafting style.

**Why you need it:**

*   No frustrating randomness — get the cassettes you want, whenever you want.
*   Create duplicates for decoration, jukeboxes, or automation.
*   Fully compatible with NeoForge, works on both client and server.

Whether you're building a music room, automating music production, or just want to enjoy the Vista soundtrack without limitations — this mod gives you full control over your cassette collection without breaking game balance.

If you would like to share your feedback or help us brainstorm new crafting recipes, we would be happy to receive your message at leha7cool.error@gmail.com!
